full_name: Minimal Interval Resonance Imaging in Alzheimer's Disease
institution: Dementia Research Centre, UCL Queen Square Institute of Neurology, London, UK

cohort_size.scans_per_participant: 1 baseline volumetric scan for primary benchmark (up to 9 longitudinal follow-ups held in same partition)
cohort_size.prevalent_labels: NINCDS-ADRDA Probable Alzheimer's Disease vs Cognitively Normal Elderly Control

evaluated_model_paradigms.architecture: Volume/Intensity Radiomics with Linear SVM / ElasticNet LR

evaluated_model_paradigms.pretraining: Self-supervised pretraining on public head CT/MRI volumes
AMAES masked autoencoding on FOMO260K (260,000 3D brain MRIs)

scientific_integrity_guarantees.test_set_isolation: MIRIAD is strictly zero-shot external evaluation; zero training or threshold tuning allowed on MIRIAD.
scientific_integrity_guarantees.decision_threshold_rule: Threshold locked at 0.5 (and fixed OASIS validation optimal prior).
scientific_integrity_guarantees.locked_oasis_test_state: OASIS-1 test set (N=30) remains completely untouched; no re-evaluation or modification.
scientific_integrity_guarantees.provenance_and_licensing: Compliant with MIRIAD Data Use Agreement (Malone et al. 2012 citation mandatory; no third-party redistribution).
